newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia UCM plans group rationalisation.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia UCM plans group rationalisation.

text.p: UCM Industrial Corp Bhd said on Friday it has proposed a rationalisation of its existing group structure which would involve the incorporation of a new company and its listing.
In a statement, UCM said the new investment holding company will ultimately take over the listing status of UCM.
Under a proposed scheme of arrangement, UCM shareholders will have their respective shareholdings in UCM cancelled and replaced with shares in the new company on the basis of one-for-one.
The new company will then acquire from UCM three companies -- Assedina Sdn Bhd, Jasa Kita Warehousing Sdn Bhd and UCM Realty Sdn Bhd -- for a total 48.42 million ringgit in cash.
UCM said application will be made for the delisting of its shares on the second board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange and listing of the new company on the same board.

UCM said the proposed rationalisation would provide greater flexibility in raising of funds for the continued growth of the group and streamline the group's structure based on activities which would ease implementation of corporate proposals.
The group makes and markets of automotive air-conditioning systems, components and related products.
